title: An item's state.json
description: The item's status, run state and counters, and the run state's `host`, `next` and `held`, each allowed only with its run state (`dependentSchemas`) (graphs.md, "Item data outside the document", D-615; core.md, "Run state", D-3; steps.md, "Counting"). F-137 D8 owns it; the record schema refers to its properties. A later feature that stores another fact in state.json adds its property here, in its own story. Whether `status` names a status of the item's type is the flow set's check (F-139).

run.description: The run state as stored: `idle`, `active: <box>`, `waiting: <box>`, `gated: <to status>` or `gated before: <box>` (D-3). `interrupted` is found when bl reads, never stored.

host.description: With `active: <box>` only: the host name of the process that runs the box (D-4, F-139 Decision A2).

next.description: With `idle` only: the box path where the next invocation starts; with no `next`, the item has no next box (D-3, F-139 Decision A2).

box.description: The node of the flat graph.

outcome.description: The outcome whose arrow holds the transition.

held.description: With `gated: <to status>` only: the arrow that holds the transition, by reference to the flow (D-4, F-139 Decision A2).

Counter.description: A counter of the `increment` step; a counter with no `value` reads 0.
